messages:
ops-bot: Auto-detect: cross-region LB retry surge observed, correlated with recent dns/route rollout. Severity: Sev2.
erin-k: Noticed retries jumped ~3.8x around 05:12 UTC, mostly us-west -> eu-north. Backend healthy, TLS handshake failures in logs.
samir-r: Looks like rollout-2211 changed DNS TTL and route reconciliation timing. I see route apply bursts at the same timestamps.
beth-l: Repro from ap-east probe -> eu-north: curl shows TLS unexpected_message then 502. snippet:
``n$ curl -I https://api.redwood.example/health --resolve api.redwood.example:443:18.204.12.9
HTTP/2 502
* TLSv1.3 alert (unexpected_message)
``n
oscar: Short action list (owners + ETA):
- Action 1: Confirm whether rollout-2211 toggled TTL or included a control-plane apply change. Owner: @samir-r. ETA: 8h. Ticket NET-6010.
- Action 2: Hotfix: apply temporary client-side backoff multiplier for cross-region retries. Owner: @erin-k. ETA: 2h.
- Action 3: Deploy tls-resume-canary across regions to watch for reneg/resume failures. Owner: @beth-l. ETA: 48h.
- Action 4: RFC to add route-apply dedupe guard during DNS-originated events. Owner: @oscar. ETA: 1 week. NET-6011.
erin-k: Pushing backoff override to 20% of traffic now, will monitor 15m window. Expect slight tail latency increase.
samir-r: I'll pull rollout artifacts and post diffs to NET-6010. If duplicate applies present, we'll trace to the reconciler logic.
beth-l: Canary scheduled in canary pool, initial baseline shows 1.5x. I'll escalate to paging if >2.
oscar: I'll start RFC draft and include an opt-out flag for emergency rolls.
erin-k: Observability follow-up: add metric tls_handshake_retry_rate tagged by rollout_id and dns_event_id. Owner: @erin-k. ETA: 72h.
samir-r: Recurrence note: this matches a pattern from last quarter where TTL/rollout timing plus TLS state led to amplified retries. Recommend a monthly runbook check. Owner: @oscar. ETA: 2 weeks.
erin-k: Summary: hotfix in flight (2h), audit (8h), canary (48h), RFC (1w). We'll reconvene after hotfix and postmortem assignment. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress. Updates will be appended to this thread.
